name: تحديد متى يرسب الطالب في المقرر (الحالة 3)
description: بناء برنامج يحدد ما إذا رسب الطالب في المقرر بناءً على المدخلات التي يتلقاها من المدرس. الطالب يرسب في المقرر إذا لم تكن درجته أعلى من متوسط الصف.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Iqra madkhalat al-mudarris
text = input("Adkhil darajat al-taleb:")
student_score = int(text)
text = input("Adkhil mutawassit al-saff:")
class_average = int(text)
#Khatwa 2: Uktub ta'bir boolean litaqrir hal al-taleb raseb fi al-muqarrar
is_failing = not ( student_score > class_average )
#Khatwa 3: Taba al-nateejah
if is_failing == True :
    print("Naam! Al-taleb raseb fi al-muqarrar.")
else:
    print("La! Al-taleb la yarseb fi al-muqarrar.")

untr_name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 3)
untr_description: Construct a program that determines whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if his/her score is not above the class average.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the instructor inputs
text = input("Enter the student's score:")
student_score = int(text)
text = input("Enter the class average:")
class_average = int(text)
#Step 2: Write the boolean expression to determine whether the student fails the course
is_failing = not ( student_score > class_average )
#Step 3: Print the result
if is_failing == True :
    print("Yes! The student fails the course.")
else:
    print("No! The student does not fail the course.")
